Merger Agreement Excerpt: Section 9.3 – Change of Recommendation and Proposal Evaluation. Notwithstanding any provision herein, at any time during the Pre-Closing Period, the Board, or any duly constituted committee thereof, may initiate a Change of Recommendation if it determines, after consultation with both its designated financial advisor and external legal counsel, that (i) the impact of an Acquisition Proposal is not confined solely to its financial metrics but also critically hinges on strategic, operational, and market positioning factors; (ii) a bona fide negotiation period of no less than three Business Days, extendable if material amendments are forthcoming, has been observed, during which Parent is provided with full disclosure of all communicated terms and ancillary market intelligence; (iii) any proposed amendments to financial terms simultaneously trigger a reassessment of the non-financial aspects such as governance, risk exposure, and long-term sustainability; and (iv) the fiduciary duties of the Board, which require an integrated approach encompassing both monetary and non-monetary evaluations, would be compromised by relying exclusively on the financial point of view. Furthermore, if any party suggests alterations that marginally improve the financial returns while adversely affecting the strategic market position, such proposals shall not be deemed to qualify as Superior Proposals under the terms of this Agreement.
